description: This PHP class defines a command-line tool within the OrangeHRM testing framework that restores a database to a specified savepoint. It includes configuration for the command name and arguments, and executes the restoration process by invoking a service.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class for restoring database to a specific savepoint within the OrangeHRM testing framework.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this console command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and required arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database restoration to the specified savepoint and outputs a success message.
